newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA POISED FOR THIRD TEST VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA POISED FOR THIRD TEST VICTORY.

text.p: Australia were heading for victory in the third test after reducing England to 130 for five on Sunday as they chased a massive 469 to win.
England lost their first four wickets in the second innings in a spell of 37 balls either side of tea. Only John Crawley, playing for his place after a poor run, resisted, with an unbeaten 53.
Australia declared their second innings at 395 for eight, Steve Waugh becoming the first batsman for 50 years to make two centuries in an Ashes encounter.
Not even the English weather, which has been poor in recent weeks, is likely to deny Australia a victory to level the six-match series at 1-1. The forecast for Monday's final day is "dry and warm".
